source.title: A Modular Framework for Reinforcement Learning Optimal Execution

claims.statement: The TWAP benchmark partitions an execution interval into buckets and distributes order submission timestamps evenly over bucket duration.
A TWAP algorithm may decide its child-order schedule and volumes in advance.

adaptations: This package implements only the deterministic TWAP benchmark schedule, not the paper's reinforcement-learning agent or its improvement over the benchmark.

The public AAPL daily bars are a runtime proxy for the paper's intraday BTC order-book snapshots. Each trading bar is treated as one equal scheduling slot; holiday and overnight clock time is excluded.

The runtime's submit_order action is a next-bar market order. The paper's limit-order queue and market cleanup at bucket boundaries, LOB fill model, slippage and experimental rewards are not reproduced.
A parent buy of 12 shares across 12 slots is a declared local scenario, not the paper's 100 BTC five-minute experiment.
